Combined into ONE file here (unlike รั้วแบบที่ 1's หน้า26, which split C1 and GB into two separate files) because both boxes on this sheet are BYTE-IDENTICAL repeats of หน้า26's C1/GB specs (same dimensions, same bar counts, same diameters, same spacing, same bent-bar note) -- re-verified by direct comparison, not assumed. Splitting two files that carry zero new information into two separate files would add nothing; this deliberate simplification is noted explicitly rather than silently done.

This exact repetition (C1 and GB identical between the two fence types) confirms the design office's standard: only the infill/capping system changes between รั้วแบบที่ 1 and 2, the structural frame is one shared design.
